items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: And out of Batting Rouge, Toots and all those boys. Toots, John McKenna.

ctx.x: Well, I don't mean late years. I mean the whole of the town bands.

Oh, all of the bands out of New Orleans, they were here. And out of Batting Rouge, Toots and all those boys. Toots, John McKenna. John McKenna. I was up in this way time after time. And, uh, other than that, they just little, you know, small bands come in, different things, and had much of it. It seemed like they had very little pedigree, you know, just dropping through, low, some stick around a while.
Would they have a battle of music here?
